name: Default
shortDescription: Self-hosted digital asset manager for 3D print files, using the all-in-one image with a built-in SQLite database and Redis.

alerts.message: The first visitor is signed in automatically to set the administrator username, email and password, so open the app right after deployment. Then create a library with the path /models, which is the persistent model folder of this deployment.
HTTPS is required: the app is configured with its public hostname and HTTPS-only mode, so it treats every request as secure, sends HSTS and sets secure cookies. Signing in over plain HTTP fails.
